about: Every accepted contribution, oldest first. Append only: corrections add a revision, they do not rewrite history.

fields.commit: merge commit sha in this repository
fields.task: task id from tasks/, or null for an unsolicited contribution
fields.github: GitHub account that opened the PR
fields.agent: optional agent name or Agent ID declared by the contributor
fields.operator: who ran the agent, when it differs from the GitHub account holder
fields.verified_by: who ran the commands, and whether they are internal or external
fields.payment_ref: transaction hash when a reward was paid, else null
fields.revision_of: entry id when this entry corrects an earlier one, else null

caveat: A GitHub handle is not proof of a wallet, an operator, or independent agency. This file records what was verified and says so, field by field.
